summary: CW-002C terminal QA independently reinspected all five current tracer PNGs. Go, Kaizen Metrics, NinjaOne, and Career World retain their approved hashes and PASS scores. Evergreen is rejected at 83.25: its canonical tall crown has seven stepped tiers versus four in the middle and five on the right, the bottom panel is outlined/full-detail rather than a solid silhouette, and pixel-equivalent terrain-pad geometry is not established. Final verdict: STOP; do not promote full fanout. A separate Director hold also blocks canonical fanout until concept outputs move from runtime public/ to design/career-world/concepts/ and refreshed manifest/batch SHA evidence is issued.
